The 2007 Formula 1 drivers' championship was won by Kimi Räikkönen of Ferrari, with 110 points and 6 wins. He finished one point ahead of Lewis Hamilton (McLaren, 109 points) and level with Fernando Alonso (McLaren, 109 points) on points, with Alonso second on the tiebreak. The standings list shows Räikkönen ahead of both, so I'm treating him as champion.

ANSWER: Kimi Räikkönen
